title:
Property moves
like *dominoes*
source: source: MND / HDB announcements, Jul & Aug 2026
caption:
Singapore property moves like dominoes: HDB, then EC, then private condo. 🁢

The 15 month wait is gone and the EC income ceiling is now $18,000. Both bring more buyers in.

Which domino are you watching? Comment HDB, EC or CONDO 👇

lines.say: You are the government. You have thousands of new BTO flats to sell.
lines.cap: you are the government. you have *thousands of new BTO flats* to sell

lines.say: If resale flats cost far more, new BTOs look like a bargain.
lines.cap: if resale costs far more, *new BTOs look like a bargain*

lines.say: And when HDB moves, ECs follow. Then private condos.
lines.cap: when HDB moves, *ECs follow*. then private condos

lines.say: HDB, then EC, then condo. That's the domino effect.
lines.cap: HDB, then EC, then condo. *the domino effect*

lines.say: Recent moves. The fifteen month wait, scrapped. The EC income ceiling, raised to eighteen thousand.
lines.cap: 15 month wait *scrapped*. EC income ceiling *raised to $18,000*

lines.say: Which domino are you watching? Tell us below.
lines.cap: which domino are you watching? comment *HDB, EC or CONDO*
